files.cause: tiny UserUnit underflows a positive box to width 0 and the geometry was returned

files.kind: panic (writer output only reopens with repair)
files.cause: empty dict key (`/` then `1`): pdf-writer pads only after a regular byte, so the output read `/1`, a key without a value

files.cause: 1e9-pixel image reached the renderer past the budget scan; hayro decoded it uncapped

files.cause: inline image data that contains EI but no real terminator was cut at the last EI (trailing bytes dropped), so re-emission was not stable
files.fix: writer/content.rs: copy the reader's whole inline-image span; also refuse (MALFORMED_PDF) any instruction that does not read back as one instruction

files.cause: nested garbage inline images (BI ID ... BI ID, EI inside data) re-emit differently on the second pass
files.fix: writer/content.rs: output must be a fixed point of re-emission, else MALFORMED_PDF (ADR 0002)
files.origin: synthetic, minimized by cargo fuzz tmin from a fuzz-smoke finding

files.cause: a flate stream inflating to 4 MiB of one-byte junk tokens: re-emission looked each token up in a 74-entry operator slice (~0.4 s native for a 10 KB file)
files.fix: writer/content.rs: operator check is a match, not a slice scan (~2x faster); the junk is still dropped, output stays under 8 KiB (NEW-122)
